user.title: Connect to Schluter DITRA-HEAT-E-RS1
user.description: Enter your Schluter refresh token. We'll automatically detect your locations. See documentation for easy token extraction method (30 seconds!).

data_description.refresh_token: This is your browser Session-Id (the session-id header the website sends). YES — it is the same value Home Assistant asks for here as the 'Refresh Token'; it is NOT the site's separate refreshToken cookie. Get it in ~30s: log in at schluterditraheat.com, press F12, and in the Console run: document.cookie.split(';').map(c=>c.trim()).find(c=>c.startsWith('session='))?.split('=')[1]

location.title: Select Location
location.description: You have multiple locations. Select which one to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with Schluter
reauth_confirm.description: Your refresh token has expired. Get a new one using the easy method (30 seconds) - see documentation.

data_description.refresh_token: Same value as before: your browser Session-Id (session-id header). NOT the site's separate refreshToken cookie. Get it: log in at schluterditraheat.com, press F12, Console: document.cookie.split(';').map(c=>c.trim()).find(c=>c.startsWith('session='))?.split('=')[1]
